title: Proposal: working together on Costello syndrome research

sentences.text: A proposal to work together on research into HRAS-related Costello syndrome.
We are writing to the RASopathies Network because you support families affected by RASopathies, including Costello syndrome.
We have not met yet, and we would value your guidance.
HRAS changes in Costello syndrome are reported to work by gain of function, where the protein does too much.
Relevant registries include the PATRAS registry in Europe and your own contact registry.
Recruiting studies include a clinical and genetic study of RASopathies, a RASopathy biorepository and a natural history study of RASopathy cardiomyopathy.
A phase 3 MEK inhibitor trial for severe infantile hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, Baby MERIT, is not yet recruiting.
One limit: the registries and several studies enrol by syndrome, and their records do not name HRAS itself.
We would propose a study on [research question about Costello syndrome], shaped with your community from the start.
Its design, sites and funding are still to be settled: [study details].

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to discussing this idea with us?
If so, we would like to learn how your contact registry or community might take part, always with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
If this is of interest, could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you?
